title: Auto Biter
body:
# 🍖 AutoBiter

---

## Never starve. Ever again.

**AutoBiter** automatically feeds you when your hunger drops. It picks the best food, moves it to your hotbar, and eats for you — all while you focus on mining, fighting, or exploring.

![Fabric 1.21.1](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fabric-1.21.1-green?style=flat-square) ![Client-side](https://img.shields.io/badge/Client--side-only-blue?style=flat-square) ![MIT License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow?style=flat-square)

---

### ✨ Features

- 🍽️ **Automatic eating** — Eats food from your inventory when hunger drops below threshold
- 🏆 **Smart food selection** — Always picks the most nutritious food available (saturation + hunger value)
- 📊 **Configurable threshold** — Set when AutoEat activates (2–20 hunger points)
- 🔄 **Auto hotbar swap** — Moves food to hotbar and swaps back to your previous item after eating
- 📋 **HUD status display** — Shows "EATING" / "READY" status and current threshold
- 🎨 **Color-coded warnings** — Green (full), Yellow (getting hungry), Red (eating now!)
- ⏱️ **Cooldown system** — Prevents rapid eating attempts with a 1-second cooldown
- 🔄 **Full toggle** — Enable or disable AutoEat anytime with a keybind
- 🛡️ **Combat-friendly** — Won't interfere with your PvP — eat manually anytime

### ⌨️ Keybinds

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| *(configurable)* | Toggle AutoBiter on/off |
| *(configurable)* | Increase hunger threshold (+2) |
| *(configurable)* | Decrease hunger threshold (-2) |

### 🧠 How Smart Food Selection Works

AutoBiter ranks all food in your inventory using a combined score:

```
Score = Saturation + Nutrition

Golden Carrot:  6.0 + 14.4 = 20.4 ★★★★★
Golden Apple:   4.0 + 9.6  = 13.6 ★★★★
Steak:          8.0 + 12.8 = 20.8 ★★★★★
Cooked Pork:    8.0 + 12.8 = 20.8 ★★★★★
Bread:          5.0 + 6.0  = 11.0 ★★★
Cookie:         2.0 + 0.4  = 2.4  ★
```

It always picks the best food first — no more wasting golden apples when bread would do!

### 💡 Perfect for

- ⛏️ **Mining sessions** — Focus on mining, not on eating
- ⚔️ **Combat/PvE** — Keep your hunger full for natural regeneration
- 🏗️ **Building** — Never stop placing blocks to eat
- 🌾 **AFK farming** — Stay alive while your farms produce
- 🗺️ **Exploring** — Walk thousands of blocks without worrying about food

### 📥 Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) for Minecraft 1.21.1
2. Download [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) and place it in `.minecraft/mods/`
3. Place `autoeat-1.0.0.jar` in `.minecraft/mods/`
4. Launch and enjoy!

### ⚙️ Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader 0.16.14+
- Fabric API
- Java 21+
